description: Arctic ERMA® (Environmental Response Management Application) is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office of Response and Restoration; NOAA Office for Coastal Management; U.S. Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement. As Arctic sea ice continues to contract and thin, energy exploration and transportation activities will be increasing in the region, escalating the risk of oil spills and accidents. In anticipation, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) and interagency partners are actively preparing for these possible emergencies. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
